channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ódio a Moraes empolga mais a direita do que amor a Flávio
item.description: The text emphasizes that the September 7th far-right protests will focus on criticizing Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but the alleged 'hatred for Moraes' drives greater mobilization. Funding from banker Daniel Vorcaro to both figures is framed as a central issue, however, the tone suggests the right-wing is more energized by opposition to Moraes than by defending Flávio.

item.title: Lula: não quero depender da China e dos EUA, queremos inteligência artificial em português
item.description: Lula states that Brazil should not rely on China or the US for AI development and advocates for technology produced in Portuguese.

item.title: O conselho sobre o Pix que Lula diz que dará a Trump na ONU
item.description: Lula framed the Pix as a sovereignty issue in his campaign, mocking Trump by suggesting he adopt the Brazilian payment system. The Pix is targeted by U.S. tariffs for threatening the credit card market. Lula also advocated for technological independence in AI, rejecting reliance on either the U.S. or China.

item.title: Vídeo compara ministros do STF a porcos de livro de George Orwell
item.description: A 38-second AI-generated video likens STF ministers and the Senate president to pigs, referencing George Orwell's 'Animal Farm', amid corruption investigations involving the Banco Master and fake news. The content uses digitally altered images of real moments of the justices and indirect criticism of the judiciary.

item.title: Trabalho de Galípolo no BC é “decepcionante”, diz Boulos
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos deemed Gabriel Galípolo's performance at the Central Bank disappointing, criticizing the pace of Selic rate cuts. He advocated for a multiple mandate for the BC, similar to the Fed, including employment alongside inflation, and questioned the BC's autonomy approved under Bolsonaro.

item.title: Haddad relaciona Banco Master à família Bolsonaro e os chama de máfia
item.description: Haddad accuses the Master Bank of being a mafia linked to the Bolsonaro family, citing alleged payments to ministers and candidates. He also criticizes Tarcísio de Freitas and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula diz que vai sugerir a Trump criar um Pix nos EUA
item.description: Lula mocked U.S. criticisms of the Pix payment system and said he will recommend that Trump create a similar system in the United States. The statement was made during a rally in São José do Rio Preto, following a White House report warning that Pix could harm U.S. companies like Visa and Mastercard.

item.title: Foto de ministros do STF gargalhando vira meme
item.description: A photo of Supreme Court ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Gilmar Mendes laughing during a session on September 2 went viral on social media and became the subject of memes, with criticism over the perceived involvement of the Judiciary in the crisis involving the defunct Bank Master and former minister Luiz Antônio dos Santos. The memes question the ministers' stance and raise concerns about polarization and institutional integrity in Brazil.

item.title: Espanha além do óbvio: 12 lugares que parecem cenário de filme
item.description: The article highlights lesser-known Spanish tourist destinations such as Siurana, El Hierro, Montserrat, and Tossa de Mar, showcasing unique natural and historical landscapes. Although it references real locations, the content is tourism-focused and unrelated to the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Augusto Cury faz carreata em Araçatuba e volta a atacar polarização
item.description: Augusto Cury held a rally in Araçatuba, criticizing the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro and advocating for a campaign focused on proposals. He claimed Brazil does not belong to two political families and called for inclusive pacification of various religious groups and atheists.

item.title: Lula diz que não quer depender de EUA e China para IA e acusou Trump de querer ‘acabar com o Pix’
item.description: Lula states Brazil does not want to depend on China or the US for AI development and advocates for homegrown technology like Pix. He criticizes Trump for allegedly wanting to ban Pix and highlights progress in gov.br usage. Lula also supports raising the minimum wage above inflation and responds to criticisms about the cost of living.

item.title: Atlas/Focus: Lula tem 51,6% no Ceará; Flávio Bolsonaro aparece com 25,7%
item.description: In a Ceará survey, Lula leads with 51.6% of voters, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 25.7%. In simulated runoff scenarios, Lula maintains a significant advantage over all opponents.

item.title: Dinho Ouro Preto cobra ministros do STF no Rock in Rio; assista
item.description: Dinho Ouro Preto of Capital Inicial demanded explanations from Supreme Court justices, Daniel Vorcaro, and politicians during Rock in Rio, dedicating the song 'Que País É Este' to them. The manifestation occurred after new revelations in the Master case, including messages between Vorcaro and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The Federal Police also identified edits made by Moraes to a billionaire contract involving his wife's law firm.

item.title: Tarcísio recebeu dinheiro do Master para se eleger, diz Haddad
item.description: Haddad accused Tarcísio of receiving donations from Banco Master for his 2022 election during a campaign event in São José do Rio Preto. The statement occurs amid the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race.

item.title: No RS, Caiado se reúne com setor agro e promete apoio a endividados
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado visited Expointer in Rio Grande do Sul to discuss support for agribusiness, especially indebted producers and post-flood reconstruction. He also advocated for lifting confidentiality on STF proceedings and criticized polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula em comício: "Trump, faça um Pix para você ver como é bom"
item.description: President Lula criticized Trump for attempting to weaken Pix, suggesting he use the platform to understand its value. During an event in São Paulo, he advocated for Brazil's technological autonomy, particularly in Artificial Intelligence, and reaffirmed that no one will change Pix. The statement followed U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods justified by allegedly unfair payment practices.

item.title: Nova pesquisa AtlasIntel mostra disputa Lula x Flávio após escândalo no STF e testa Cury no segundo turno
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro amid the Supreme Court crisis and Banco Master scandal. The survey tests first and second round scenarios, including Augusto Cury, measuring rejection, trust, and voting intentions.

item.title: Lula ignora STF, pede voto em Haddad e mira Tarcísio em ato no interior de SP
item.description: Lula spoke at a campaign event in São José do Rio Preto, supporting Haddad and attacking Tarcísio, while ignoring criticism of the STF. The rallies addressed security, education, economy and artificial intelligence, with Haddad accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of irregularities and criticizing the Banco Master. The event brought together leaders of the governing coalition to strengthen the PT candidacy in São Paulo.

item.title: Fernando Haddad sobre Tarcísio: "Recebeu dinheiro do Master para se eleger"
item.description: Fernando Haddad accused Tarcísio de Freitas of receiving irregular donations from Banco Master during the 2022 election, linking the scandal to the Bolsonaro administration and questioning the source of campaign funds. At an event in São José do Rio Preto, Haddad labeled the situation as a 'mafia' and reiterated criticisms regarding Metro Line 6, demanding transparency and accountability.

item.title: Deltan divulga sigilo fiscal de ministro do STF em registro de candidatura
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol added confidential documents of Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin to his candidacy filing, breaching fiscal and banking secrecy. The files, obtained in 2019 by Operation Car Wash and later annulled by the Supreme Court, were used to strengthen his defense against challenges to his Senate campaign in Paraná.

item.title: José Dirceu conclui tratamento contra linfoma e ficará resguardado por quatro semanas
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT), 80, completed lymphoma treatment at São Paulo's Hospital Sírio-Libanês and was advised to remain in isolation for four weeks. He continues his campaign for a congressional seat by São Paulo, with elections scheduled for October 4.

item.title: Cury omitiu cinco empresas na declaração de bens à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) failed to report five companies in his asset declaration to the Electoral Justice, including three registered in Florida. He declared assets worth R$242.3 million to the TSE, but omitted some companies where he holds authorized membership.

item.title: “Estamos em guerra”: Tebet convoca mulheres contra Flávio e Tarcísio
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) called on women to vote against Tarcísio de Freitas and Flávio Bolsonaro, accusing both of disrespect toward women and education. At an event in São José do Rio Preto, Tebet declared that Brazil is at war against fascism and the Bolsonaro family, highlighting criticism of the former government. She also announced Alfredo Gaspar as vice-presidential candidate for the 2026 ticket.

item.title: Augusto Cury omitiu negócios nos EUA da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury failed to declare to the Brazilian Electoral Justice a series of businesses located in Florida, United States. The omission was identified in his asset declaration and may constitute a campaign irregularity. Cury ranks third in the polls for the presidency.

item.title: Flávio ‘joga a toalha’ no Nordeste, enquanto Lula tenta reagir em ato com evangélicos na Baixada Fluminense
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro cuts losses in the Northeast and focuses the campaign on the North and Southeast, while Lula responds with a rally in São Gonçalo backed by evangelicals to counter the growth of PL allies in Rio.

item.title: Erika Hilton aciona MPSP por fala de Vorcaro sobre propina
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton and state candidate Sofia Favero filed a complaint with the São Paulo State Public Prosecutor's Office accusing Governor Tarcísio de Freitas of involvement in a kickback scheme through a supposed R$2 million donation from Banco Master. The allegations stem from a plea bargain agreement by Daniel Vorcaro, who claims funds were directed to Tarcísio's 2022 campaign and former President Bolsonaro's, with mediation by Gilberto Kassab.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio visita Filipe Martins em Ponta Grossa
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro visits Filipe Martins at Ponta Grossa Public Jail, where he is serving a 21-year sentence for attempted coup d'état. The visit was authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Lula critica gestão Bolsonaro durante pandemia: ‘poderiam ter sido evitadas 400 mil mortes’
item.description: Lula criticized Bolsonaro's management during the pandemic, stating that 400,000 deaths could have been prevented. He emphasized the importance of SUS and contrasted Brazil's health system with that of the US. The statements were made during a visit to the Hospital de Amor de Barretos.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acusa Alcolumbre de proteger Moraes e diz haver articulação contra sua candidatura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accuses Davi Alcolumbre of protecting Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and suggests there is a coordinated effort involving Alcolumbre, Moraes, and Flávio Dino to undermine his candidacy. He renews calls for Moraes' impeachment and denies any wrongdoing in the 'Dark Horse' film.

item.title: A grande preocupação de Lula no embate entre Alexandre de Moraes e André Mendonça
item.description: President Lula is concerned about the crisis between STF ministers, particularly Mendonça's alleged intention to disqualify the PF director and the attempt to associate him with Moraes, viewed as harmful for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha diz que 'direcionamento' de Mendonça deve gerar arquivamento
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva stated in a press release that the Federal Police intelligence report mentioning Mendonça's direction should lead to the case being archived, claiming there are no irregularities.

item.title: Relatório de inteligência da PF expõe divisão interna sobre Lulinha e sugere acionar Corregedoria
item.description: The PF intelligence report reveals internal divisions regarding investigations involving Fábio Lula and suggests filing a complaint with the CGM over a biased codename. The document rates information as low reliability and warns of reputational risk to the president's son.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha vê relatório da PF como argumento para arquivar investigação
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) uses a federal police intelligence report to request the dismissal of investigations related to INSS, questioning the performance of Minister André Mendonça and pointing to alleged irregularities in the conduct of inquiries. The document highlights lack of solid evidence against Lulinha and disagreement compared to other defendants.

item.title: Nos EUA, o pobre não tem o que tem no Brasil, diz Lula sobre SUS
item.description: During a visit to the Hospital de Amor in Barretos, Lula highlighted universal access to the SUS, contrasting it with the high costs of healthcare in the US, citing journalist Terrence McCoy's case. He also criticized Bolsonaro's pandemic management, recalling disinformation such as linking vaccines to sexual orientation.

item.title: Não se pode igualar Mendonça a Moraes
item.description: André Mendonça's appointment to the STF by Jair Bolsonaro in 2021 represents an unprecedented judicial polarization. Unlike previous more balanced appointments, this choice reflects an explicit ideological alignment. The text argues that comparing Mendonça to Moraes is inappropriate due to distinct contexts.

item.title: Representante do Brasil no Miss Mundo, Gabriela Botelho escolhe look inspirado no barroco mineiro para a final
item.description: Gabriela Botelho represents Brazil in the Miss World 2026 final wearing a blue baroque-inspired dress with exposed back and matching cape. With a degree in Business and Fashion Design, she is an ambassador for Casa de Maria and volunteered in Brumadinho after the dam collapse.

item.title: Em Barretos, Lula diz que SUS “ressurgiu das cinzas” e critica negacionismo
item.description: During a visit to a hospital in Barretos, Lula highlighted the role of SUS during the pandemic, stating that the system 'rose from the ashes' and criticized Bolsonaro's denialism regarding the Covid-19 vaccine, calling criminal statements that downplayed the effects of immunization. The president also reaffirmed the commitment to equitable access to health treatments in Brazil.

item.title: João Amoêdo vê Cury em alta, critica silêncio do Supremo no caso Moraes e ainda não define voto
item.description: João Amoêedo, outside partisan politics since leaving the New party, comments on Augusto Cury's rise in polls, criticizes the Supreme Court's silence in the Alexandre de Moraes case, and has not yet decided on his support.

item.title: Eleições 2026: candidaturas de autistas aumentam mais de cinco vezes
item.description: Autistic candidacies in Brazil grew more than fivefold between 2022 and 2026, rising from 13 to 70 filings. Notable are 39 running for state deputy and 22 for federal deputy. This increase reflects greater social visibility and recognition of disability rights, according to experts.

item.title: Investigação contra vice de Flávio Bolsonaro deve ser arquivada no STF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes ordered the PGR to comment on the possible closure of the investigation against Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, for rape. The complaint emerged during the INSS CPI as an attempt to disqualify Gaspar, but was discovered to be false, fabricated by a merchant. The Prosecutor's Office has no deadline to decide on closing the case.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula vê “crise profunda” no STF e fala em modernização
item.description: Sergio Gabrielli, coordinator of Lula's government program, stated that the STF is facing a deep crisis and supports the modernization of the Judiciary, but emphasized that this is not part of a government plan. Lula also reinforced the need for pacification among the Powers and impartial investigations, although his program does not detail specific reforms for the Judiciary.

item.title: Valor de doações a Tarcísio é 260 vezes maior que o recebido por Haddad
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas campaign raised R$3.9 million in individual donations, 260 times more than the R$15,000 received by Fernando Haddad. Despite the disparity, the overall cash balances are similar, with Tarcísio holding R$13.7 million compared to Haddad's R$13.09 million including party transfers.

item.title: Crepúsculo dos deuses (por André Gustavo Stumpf)
item.description: The text examines the cycle of rise and fall of Brazilian political leaders like Collor, Dirceu, Moro and Lula, highlighting how issues they created led to imprisonment or loss of office. It illustrates the volatility of political careers through power games, allegations, and judicial proceedings.

item.title: Nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus testa Lula x Flávio após crise no STF e cenário com Cury no segundo turno
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro following the Supreme Court crisis, testing various electoral scenarios including potential head-to-head matchups in a second round.

item.title: Fluminense e Vasco fazem clássico carioca em momentos distintos no Brasileirão
item.description: Fluminense and Vasco face off at Maracanã in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship, with the Tricolor unbeaten and in fourth place, while the Cruz-Maltino seeks to escape the relegation zone. The match follows Vasco's advancement to the Copa do Brasil semifinals.

item.title: Botafogo x Palmeiras: Escalações, desfalques, retrospecto, onde assistir, arbitragem e palpites
item.description: Botafogo faces Palmeiras in the 26th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship at 6:30 PM at Nilton Santos Stadium, broadcasted on Premiere, Record, and CazéTV. With 30 points and under pressure to escape relegation, the Rio de Janeiro team seeks to reverse two losses. Managed by Abel Ferreira, the league leaders aim to extend their lead.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (5 e 6)
item.description: This weekend, presidential candidates carry out campaign events such as launches, walks, leafleting, and visits, with emphasis on Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, Zema, Caiado, and others. Each candidate follows a political agenda across various regions of Brazil, involving public appearances, interviews, and meetings with voters and allies.

item.title: Fachin indica intenção de levar ao plenário crise envolvendo Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: The President of the Supreme Court, Edson Fachin, signaled to Lula his intention to bring the crisis involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça to the plenary session. The crisis stems from accusations and inquiries requiring a collective review by the Court. Fachin emphasized the need for a firm response to the gravity of revelations, particularly the connections between banker Daniel Vorcaro and judicial and political figures.

item.title: Letícia Barros na Crusoé: Renan Santos e o Judiciário que dita o algoritmo
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court unilaterally removed a piece from Renan Santos's campaign board, 14 days after the campaign began. Renan, who previously supported Moraes's actions against Bolsonaro in 2021, now faces judicial decisions affecting his electoral trajectory in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Cruzeiro x Athletico-PR: prováveis escalações, arbitragem, onde assistir, retrospecto e palpites
item.description: Cruzeiro and Athletico-PR face off in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship at Mineirão, with the match scheduled for Sunday at 4 PM. The Raposa, in fourth place, aims to maintain its strong form with four consecutive wins, while the Furacão, third-place, seeks to surprise away from home.
